argv: let pkgs = import (import /work/ci/nixpkgs.nix) {}; in (import /work/.agent-output/pin-mutant/default.nix { inherit pkgs; }).name
commands.mutation: Appended newline and ;; digest mutation control to scratch copy of vendored wal.cljc

inputs: Every crash case starts with init, put a=old, put b=keep. Then put a=new or checkpoint, paused at half-written, written, file-synced, renamed or dir-synced for each new object/root. Each writer exit is 137; fresh process reader checks exact state/tail/checkpoint; concurrent writer denied while child owns lock; later write/read succeeds. All data is synthetic.
downloads: No tooling installed. Existing Nix/babashka caches used. Anonymous GitHub source-archive prefetch returned HTTP 404; the dependency is an exact git-show copy of the authorized merged upstream module, verified byte-for-byte and pinned by SHA-256.
developmentNotes: Fixed initial unsupported Babashka exception class import, a delimiter error and FileChannel.open overload selection during smoke checks. Closing the lock-owning channel replaces unavailable FileLock.release reflection.
An initial 4-test run exposed accidentally nested deftest forms; top-level forms were checked and the final 9-test suite is recorded.
Self-review added directory sync when reusing renamed orphan objects and refuses further mutation of degraded stores; final host and Linux checks were rerun.
Original unrelated read-only Nix container disappeared before artifact collection; outputs were copied using a task-owned one-shot container without altering another service.
qualification: Otehon hosted Babashka adapter and Nix package tests on aarch64 Linux container, plus macOS. NixOS option evaluation, not NixOS boot or VM integration. No production install/cutover, real-user volume, Pack/CAR encryption, independent peer, hardware/power-loss, cache-cold, RPO/RTO or Kotoba/Amu native qualification.
